content:
FINAL IVX PRODUCTION CLOSEOUT — EXECUTE, DO NOT REPLAN

Do NOT return another certification report unless all remaining blockers have either been completed with live evidence or clearly marked as owner-only infrastructure.

The registration reliability work is accepted. Now complete ONLY the remaining production blockers.

==================================================
PHASE 1 — CLOUDFRONT
==================================================

Invalidate the production CloudFront distribution.

Required:

- Invalidate /index.html
- Invalidate all registration assets if required
- Verify the newest index.html is being served
- Verify no stale cache remains

Return:

- Distribution ID
- Invalidation ID
- Completion status
- ETag
- Last-Modified
- Runtime commit SHA
- CloudFront cache status

==================================================
PHASE 2 — DATABASE CONSTRAINTS
==================================================

Execute the committed migration in production.

Verify:

- members.auth_user_id UNIQUE
- profiles.auth_user_id UNIQUE
- normalized_email UNIQUE
- registration_request_id UNIQUE
- required foreign keys
- indexes created successfully

Return:

- migration filename
- migration version
- SQL execution result
- verification queries
- production proof

==================================================
PHASE 3 — SMTP
==================================================

If SMTP is not configured:

DO NOT mark PASS.

Instead return:

- exact provider required
- exact DNS records required
- SPF
- DKIM
- DMARC
- sender domain
- sender address
- verification steps

When SMTP is configured:

Verify:

- email confirmation
- password reset
- resend confirmation
- delivery success

Return live proof.

==================================================
PHASE 4 — REAL DEVICE QA
==================================================

Run production QA on:

✓ Samsung Browser
✓ Android Chrome
✓ Desktop Chrome
✓ Desktop Safari
✓ iPhone Safari

Verify:

- registration
- login
- logout
- password reset
- email confirmation
- session persistence
- refresh
- back button
- duplicate submit
- slow network
- reconnect
- keyboard
- orientation

Return PASS/FAIL for every test.

==================================================
PHASE 5 — LANDING PAGE QA
==================================================

Audit every public landing module:

- Hero
- Statistics
- Investment cards
- Reels
- Images
- Video
- Registration
- Login
- Forgot password
- Member creation
- Investors
- Buyers
- Properties
- Deal details
- Documents
- Media
- Notifications
- Footer
- Mobile responsiveness
- SEO
- Analytics

For each module:

PASS or FAIL

If FAIL provide:

- file
- function
- root cause
- corrective action

==================================================
PHASE 6 — PERFORMANCE
==================================================

Audit:

- loading indicators
- image lazy loading
- video buffering
- cache strategy
- API batching
- pagination
- optimistic updates
- React rendering
- memory leaks
- duplicate requests
- websocket reconnect
- offline recovery

Target:

Instagram-quality experience.

No frozen loading.
No white screen.
No endless spinner.
No duplicate API calls.

==================================================
PHASE 7 — REELS
==================================================

Fix and verify:

- no crash after several seconds
- smooth scrolling
- preload next video
- automatic cache cleanup
- background recovery
- upload
- playback
- comments
- likes
- share
- recovery after reconnect

Return real device evidence.

==================================================
PHASE 8 — DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

Deploy only after all fixes pass.

Return:

GitHub Commit SHA
Render Deploy ID
Runtime SHA
CloudFront Version
APK Version
Production URL
/health response

Verify:

Runtime SHA == GitHub SHA

==================================================
FINAL REPORT
==================================================

PASS or FAIL for:

✓ CloudFront
✓ SMTP
✓ Database Constraints
✓ Device QA
✓ Landing QA
✓ Registration
✓ Login
✓ Member Creation
✓ Reels
✓ Performance
✓ Security
✓ Production Deployment

Do NOT report PASS without live evidence.

If any item remains incomplete, identify the exact blocker, whether it is code or owner infrastructure, and provide the exact corrective action.

Objective:

Deliver IVX Holdings as a production-ready, owner-controlled enterprise platform with stable registration, stable authentication, Instagram-quality user experience, reliable media rendering, enterprise QA, and verifiable production evidence.
